name: Fate of China: Emergency Action
text: The year is 2050, our glorious nation, the People's Republic of China was in a nuclear war. Luckily, our forefathers constructed a series of defences officially called 'The Third Line Construction' in the 1970s. Nicknamed [The Underground Great Wall]. It was constantly maintained and expanded under tense international conflicts up until the final moment. We have been relying on this legacy for about 20 years. Until now, the radiation level has gone down remarkably and we need to bear the responsibility of raising the red flag again.
